content.text:
The data clearly supports **zone sensor fault**:

- F3_Z01's sensor tracks its cooling setpoint (≈25.2 C) with high accuracy (mean 25.1, std 1.17), even in winter when other zones drop to ~21–23 C (heating season).
- Neighboring zones (F3_Z02, F2_Z02, F4_Z02) show strong seasonal variation and diverge from F3_Z01 exactly from July 2018 onward.
- A genuine local load change would shift temperatures against the setpoint rather than pin the sensor to the setpoint all year. No local-load streams (e.g. zone energy) exist, but the sensor behavior itself is the evidence.
